summary.root_cause_text: The order database is read-only (filesystem, permissions or DB mode). Every write fails with 'attempt to write a readonly database', so POST /orders returns 500 and the ledger sync fails. No available tool can fix this.
recommended: A human should check the DB file and volume: permissions, read-only mount, disk full, or a SQLite file lock or ownership change. Restore write access.
After writes work, run check_invariants and confirm the ledger sync recovers. Run check_data_integrity and repair or reprocess if needed.
Have clients retry the rejected orders.
Add a write-capability check to the health probe.
Rollback and config changes were not applied because they would not fix a read-only DB.
